name: PHQA-Bench
description: Data supporting the PHKG-QA papers: the PHO pavement-hazard ontology (ASTM D6433-23 / LTPP DIM 5th / JTG 5210-2018 aligned; HermiT consistent; 29/30 competency questions), the final knowledge graph (12,014 nodes / 57,125 triples / 1,109-strict relation tier, SHACL-conformant, precision audit P=0.994), the 1,676-chunk LLM-annotated gold with disclosure fields, the 800-pair cited PHQA-Bench with a held-out 200-pair test split, the four-way OG-RAG evaluation (H1: risk-calibration 13/13 for the ontology-grounded mode vs 0/13 for ungrounded modes), and the human-validation gate artifacts (inter-annotator kappa 0.989/0.900). Source PDFs are not redistributed. Data license: CC-BY-4.0. Provenance: built from the PHKG-QA pipeline, verify_all gate 31/31 at release.
